content.what_it_is: MATLAB script (Mase-Kirby benchmark postprocessing) that overlays modeled and measured surface-elevation time series as a stacked waterfall plot. Loads 12 FUNWAVE station files sta_0001..sta_0012 (L5-9), converts eta to cm and offsets each gauge by (k-2)*10 cm (L8); takes the time base from the last-loaded gauge (L10). Plots model series for gauges 2..12 as black dashed lines (L14-19). Loads measured mketa.out (L20), builds its time base time_m=[0:N-1]*0.01+20. (L21, dt=0.01 s with a 20 s offset), offsets each of 11 measured columns by (k-1)*10 cm and plots black solid (L22-25). Axis [20 40 -10 110] over 20-40 s (L27), labels (L28-29). Builds a character table txt of 11 depth labels '35.0'..' 2.5' (L30-40) and annotates each stacked series with 'h=<depth>cm' at x=36 (L42-44). No functions; script only.
entities: script variables: fdir @L3, k @L5, num @L6, gage @L7, z @L8, time @L10, mea @L20, time_m @L21, zm @L23, txt @L30-40

equations.ref: model eta to cm with 10 cm stacking offset (gauge k offset by (k-2)*10)
measured time base, dt=0.01 s, 20 s shift
measured eta to cm with (k-1)*10 offset

calls: clear all @L1; sprintf @L6; load @L7, @L20; plot @L15, @L24; hold on @L17; grid @L26; axis @L27; xlabel @L28; ylabel @L29; text @L43
unresolved: Model gauge k is offset by (k-2)*10 (L8) and only gauges 2..12 are plotted (L14), while measured column k is offset by (k-1)*10 (L23) for k=1..11 -- i.e. model gauge k+1 is compared against measured column k; the mapping is implicit and gauge 1 (h=47 cm per the companion comp_mkskew.m) is dropped.
The measured record's 0.01 s sampling and 20 s start offset (L21) are asserted, not derived from mketa.out; model station sampling interval is whatever sta_00* column 1 contains (L10).
z is filled for k=1..12 including k=1 with negative offset -10 (L5-9) but the k=1 column is never plotted; time is taken from the last gauge only (L10), assuming all stations share one time base.
